understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel increments on the grid. Walls and boundaries can block movement, while adjacent pushable blocks may move when pushed. Movement hints are only heuristic, so actions may need testing. CLICK selects a piece using its pixel coordinates, but clicking an incorrect or inaccessible coordinate has no movement effect; multiple pieces must be switched between explicitly and positioned efficiently within the finite step budget.
